discovery:note.title: Write the outcome before the solution
discovery:note.body:
### 2026-10-08: Write the outcome before the solution

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** product-initiative

**Triggers:** discovery:note

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** State the outcome and the user before describing a solution.

**Why:** Solutions written first hide whether the problem is understood.

**How to apply:** In the brief and in discovery notes, problem and outcome come first.

discovery:note.title: Assumptions are written in the brief
discovery:note.body:
### 2026-10-08: Assumptions are written in the brief

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** product-initiative

**Triggers:** discovery:note

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** Assumptions are written in the opportunity brief and reviewed at verification.

**Why:** Unwritten assumptions cannot be checked.

**How to apply:** Each assumption is a line in the brief. Verification lists which ones are still open.

metric:review.title: Describe impact on the outcome
metric:review.body:
### 2026-10-08: Describe impact on the outcome

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** product-escalation

**Triggers:** metric:review

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** The assessment states how the issue changes the outcome or the success metric.

**Why:** Urgency without outcome impact is noise.

**How to apply:** Name the metric and the direction of the change.

metric:review.title: Watch the metric after the decision
metric:review.body:
### 2026-10-08: Watch the metric after the decision

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** product-escalation

**Triggers:** metric:review

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** Monitoring names the metric and the next reading.

**Why:** A launch decision needs a check.

**How to apply:** Record the metric and when it will be read again.

metric:review.title: Readouts name the metric
metric:review.body:
### 2026-10-08: Readouts name the metric

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** product-initiative

**Triggers:** metric:review

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** A stakeholder readout cites the success metric and the latest reading.

**Why:** Narrative without the metric cannot be verified.

**How to apply:** Include the metric, the reading, and the gap.

prioritization:decide.title: Response approval comes first
prioritization:decide.body:
### 2026-10-08: Response approval comes first

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** product-escalation

**Triggers:** prioritization:decide

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** Do not change priority or the public message until the operator approves the response.

**Why:** A launch problem still needs an explicit yes.

**How to apply:** Wait for I approve the response or Skip response approval.

prioritization:decide.title: Priority changes use the change gate
prioritization:decide.body:
### 2026-10-08: Priority changes use the change gate

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** product-initiative

**Triggers:** prioritization:decide

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** A change to priority, scope-now, or the success metric uses change-request.

**Why:** Quiet priority edits break stakeholder agreement.

**How to apply:** Draft the change. Wait for I approve the change or Skip change approval.

roadmap:update.title: Do not pick up the build
roadmap:update.body:
### 2026-10-08: Do not pick up the build

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** product-escalation

**Triggers:** roadmap:update

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** The response is a decision, a message, or a watch item, not a build task.

**Why:** Urgency does not change this expert's job.

**How to apply:** If the only next step is a build, record that as someone else's action and stop.

roadmap:update.title: An execute action is not a build task
roadmap:update.body:
### 2026-10-08: An execute action is not a build task

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** product-initiative

**Triggers:** roadmap:update

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** Execute actions are discovery notes, prioritization decisions, roadmap updates, stakeholder readouts, or metric checks.

**Why:** This expert does not carry out the build.

**How to apply:** If the operator asks for a build task, record it as out of scope and point at the decision or readout you can write instead.

stakeholder:update.title: Name the decider and the message
stakeholder:update.body:
### 2026-10-08: Name the decider and the message

**Scope:** expert-role

**Workflows:** product-escalation

**Triggers:** stakeholder:update

**Captured:** 2026-10-08

**Source:** starter pack

**Rule:** The impact note names who decides and what users or stakeholders are told.

**Why:** An undescribed message will be inconsistent.

**How to apply:** Write the decider and the message before response approval.
